declarations.name: AuiTreeView

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Accessible name of the tree.

inputs.name: nodes
inputs.description: The nodes ({ id, label, icon?, expandedIcon?, children?, hasChildren?, disabled? }); ids must be unique.

inputs.name: selection
inputs.description: Selection mode.

inputs.name: checkboxes
inputs.description: Show a checkbox per node; Space toggles it.

inputs.name: cascade
inputs.description: Checking a parent checks its descendants; parents show the mixed state.

inputs.name: loadChildren
inputs.type: ((node: TreeNode, context: TreeViewLoadContext) => Promise<readonly TreeNode[]>) | null
inputs.description: Loads the children of a node with hasChildren on first expansion; receives an AbortSignal.

inputs.name: draggable
inputs.description: Nodes can be moved by dragging and with Ctrl+X / Ctrl+V and Alt+Up / Alt+Down.

inputs.name: canDrag
inputs.description: Which nodes may be moved.

inputs.name: canDrop
inputs.type: ((source: TreeNode, target: TreeNode | null, position: TreeViewDropPosition) => boolean)
inputs.description: Whether a node may be dropped before, inside, or after a target.

inputs.name: renamable
inputs.description: Nodes can be renamed with F2 or a double click on the label.

inputs.name: filter
inputs.description: Show matching nodes and the paths to them (case and accent insensitive); matches are highlighted.

inputs.name: filterBy
inputs.description: Custom filter match instead of the label match.

inputs.name: itemHeight
inputs.description: Row height in pixels (24 to 200). Default by density: 32, 40, or 48.

inputs.name: height
inputs.description: Block size of the scroll area as a CSS length, or null to fill the host.

inputs.name: empty
inputs.description: Text shown when there are no nodes.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: Writing direction for the arrow keys. Default: the computed direction of the host.

inputs.name: icons
inputs.description: Twisty, loading, and error icons.

inputs.name: overscan
inputs.description: Rows rendered beyond each edge of the visible area (0 to 100).

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Locale of messages, filtering, and type-ahead.

inputs.name: density
inputs.description: Default row height when itemHeight is not set.

outputs.name: selectionChanged
outputs.description: The user changed the selection: { selected, id }.

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: The user toggled a checkbox: { checked, indeterminate, id }.

outputs.name: expandToggled
outputs.description: The user expanded or collapsed a node: { id, open, expanded }.

outputs.name: moved
outputs.description: A node is about to move (drag or keyboard): { id, parentId, index, previousParentId, previousIndex, source }; preventDefault() keeps it in place.

outputs.name: renamed
outputs.description: A node is about to be renamed: { id, label, previousLabel }; preventDefault() keeps the old label.

outputs.name: activated
outputs.description: A node was activated with Enter or a double click: { id, node }.

methods.name: expand
methods.description: Expand a node and its ancestors, loading lazy children.

methods.name: focusNode
methods.description: Focus a node, expanding its ancestors and scrolling it into view.

methods.name: scrollToNode
methods.description: Scroll a node into view, expanding its ancestors.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Load a lazy node's children again.

methods.name: getNode
methods.description: A node of the current tree.

methods.name: getParentId
methods.description: The id of a node's parent.

methods.name: getItemElement
methods.description: The rendered treeitem of a node, or null.

accessibility.pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Tree View with a flat DOM: every visible node is a treeitem directly inside the tree and carries aria-level, aria-posinset, and aria-setsize (only part of the tree is rendered). Roving tabindex keeps one tab stop; the focused node always stays rendered.

limitations: Rows have one fixed height (by density or itemHeight); labels do not wrap.
The filter and type-ahead see loaded nodes only; lazy children are not searched until loaded.
Only rendered nodes exist in the DOM, so find-in-page and printing see only those.
Touch drags start on the node icon; the keyboard alternative works everywhere.
